control_action: create or normalize a new standard agent draft
observed_behavior: normalizeAgent without an explicit harness chooses vscode-lm but fills the required exact vendor, family, model ID, and version with empty/auto placeholders, so the generated standard draft fails its own validator.
expected_behavior: A new standard agent draft starts with a valid deterministic PX route unless the user explicitly selects a live host model; host routes remain fail-closed until exact catalog identity is selected.
operational_impact: Generic Agent Builder entry points can generate invalid candidates before the user edits anything, undermining the visual builder's preflight and lifecycle path.

discovery_evidence.claim: The default normalizeAgent validity assertion failed in the focused editor test.
Provider selection defaults to vscode-lm when harness_id is absent, while validation requires an exact non-auto host model identity.

next_action: Default only unspecified routes to the valid deterministic harness/model tuple and retain strict exact-host-model validation after explicit host selection.

open_load.detail: The draft opens but normalized generic defaults can be invalid.

display.detail: Agent preflight can display the model route issue.

user_edit_action.detail: The user can select a host model, but should not have to repair an implicit invalid default.

input_validation.detail: Strict host identity validation correctly rejects auto placeholders.

runtime_effect.detail: The generated draft cannot pass preflight without repairing an implicit route.

result_acknowledgement.detail: Validation explains the issue but normalization created it.

failure_handling.detail: Save remains fail-closed, but no valid default recovery exists.

persistence.detail: Invalid generic draft is not yet saved.

recovery_rollback.detail: Manual live-model selection can recover, but an unspecified draft lacks an automatic valid route.
